about.missionP1: I’m Erik Budanov, founder of DigiDog and an independent product engineer. Today I run DigiDog solo, planning and building website redesigns, MVPs and integrations. You work directly with me, in English or German.
about.missionP2: AI agents support my research, implementation and testing. I choose the technical approach, review the results and take responsibility for delivery. Project scope follows your goals and a realistic delivery plan.
about.missionP3: In my own infrastructure, I reduced monthly costs from $1,200 to $210. That is my operating experience, not a promised client result. Earlier DigiDog projects retain their own project and team history.
about.value1Text: Discuss requirements and decisions with the engineer building your project. I remain responsible from planning through handover.
about.value2Text: We start with the problem: better enquiries, a usable MVP or less manual work. That becomes a clear scope with outcomes we can review.
about.value3Text: AI supports implementation. I review code and results, test important workflows and document the handover.

contact.heroDescription: I’m Erik Budanov. Share your website or describe the MVP or integration you need. We’ll clarify goals, requirements and a practical first step.
contact.formSubtitle: Describe your goal, current situation and target timeline. I’ll review your enquiry personally.
contact.formMessage: What would you like to improve or build?
contact.formMessagePlaceholder: Website, project goal, existing systems and target timeline …
contact.formThankYouSub: I’ll review your enquiry and get back to you.
contact.erikQuote: I’ll review your project personally and discuss scope, technical decisions and next steps with you.
contact.whyText1: Your enquiry comes directly to me, Erik Budanov.
contact.whyText2: Speak with the engineer who will build your project.
contact.whyText3: We’ll clarify your goal and discuss a useful next step.
contact.faq1Q: What happens in the introductory call?
contact.faq1A: We discuss your website or product idea, goals and technical requirements. Then we can agree on a useful next step and an appropriate project scope.
contact.faq2A: Timing depends on scope, existing systems and the content needed. I’ll agree on a realistic plan with you before implementation.
contact.faq3A: Once goals, scope and technical requirements are clear, I’ll prepare a project-specific proposal.
contact.faq4Q: What happens to my data during migration?
contact.faq4A: If a migration is needed, I’ll plan data transfer, access permissions and handover with you. Infrastructure choices depend on your project.
